children: What is system integration in software development?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-d2f9e60 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: System integration connects different applications, databases, and platforms so they can exchange data and work as a unified system.
What is API integration used for?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0b67e1b e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: API integration enables direct communication between systems, allowing data to move automatically without manual transfer or duplication.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-1f76e0c e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: CRM, ERP, SaaS tools, internal databases, cloud platforms, and third-party applications can all be connected through API-based integration.
How long does system integration take?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-f46d152 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Timelines depend on system complexity, number of APIs, and data flow requirements. Most integrations take 3–8 weeks.
Can legacy systems be integrated with modern tools?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-bb6017a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Legacy systems can be connected using middleware, API layers, or custom integration bridges.
What are the benefits of system integration?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ff8fa46 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: It reduces manual work, improves data accuracy, enables real-time synchronization, and improves operational efficiency.
